name: TUNA-Bench_1K
description: A compact 1,000-example benchmark from the MTEB suite for evaluating text embedding models. It measures how well embeddings capture semantic relationships for short texts across tasks such as semantic similarity, retrieval, and clustering. Intended as a quick, standardized test to compare embedding quality.
evaluation_method: Spearman correlation for similarity; nDCG / MRR for retrieval; clustering metrics for grouping tasks (task-dependent)
reputation: Part of the MTEB suite; moderately used by the embeddings community as a compact, standardized evaluation.
